text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower goes to watch the spring<n>Tenno Sho
with Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She watches as Mejiro McQueen<n>enthralls the
audience with her<n>magnificant performance.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After seeing how McQueen brings<n>happiness to
many people, Rice<n>compares her to a blue rose.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And believing that she herself, in<n>contrast, brings
misfortune to those<n>around her, Rice Shower says it
is her<n>dream to become a blue rose one day<n>as well.
